mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ACCOUNT ( codef_connection_id, user_id, organization_code, account_group, deposit_type_code, account_no_masked, account_no_hash, account_name, balance, currency_code, account_start_date, account_end_date, last_tran_date, account_lifetime, overdraft_yn, loan_kind, loan_balance, loan_start_date, loan_end_date, invested_cost, earnings_rate, loan_exec_no ) VALUES ( #{codefConnectionId}, #{userId}, #{organizationCode}, #{accountGroup}, #{depositTypeCode}, #{accountNoMasked}, #{accountNoHash}, #{accountName}, #{balance}, #{currencyCode}, #{accountStartDate}, #{accountEndDate}, #{lastTranDate}, #{accountLifetime}, #{overdraftYn}, #{loanKind}, #{loanBalance}, #{loanStartDate}, #{loanEndDate}, #{investedCost}, #{earningsRate}, #{loanExecNo} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_no_masked = VALUES(account_no_masked), account_name = VALUES(account_name), balance = VALUES(balance), currency_code = VALUES(currency_code), account_start_date = VALUES(account_start_date), account_end_date = VALUES(account_end_date), last_tran_date = VALUES(last_tran_date), account_lifetime = VALUES(account_lifetime), overdraft_yn = VALUES(overdraft_yn), loan_kind = VALUES(loan_kind), loan_balance = VALUES(loan_balance), loan_start_date = VALUES(loan_start_date), loan_end_date = VALUES(loan_end_date), invested_cost = VALUES(invested_cost), earnings_rate = VALUES(earnings_rate), loan_exec_no = VALUES(loan_exec_no)
mapper.select: SELECT id, codef_connection_id AS codefConnectionId, user_id AS userId, organization_code AS organizationCode, account_group AS accountGroup, deposit_type_code AS depositTypeCode, account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, account_no_hash AS accountNoHash, account_name AS accountName, balance, currency_code AS currencyCode, account_start_date AS accountStartDate, account_end_date AS accountEndDate, last_tran_date AS lastTranDate, account_lifetime AS accountLifetime, overdraft_yn AS overdraftYn, loan_kind AS loanKind, loan_balance AS loanBalance, loan_start_date AS loanStartDate, loan_end_date AS loanEndDate, invested_cost AS investedCost, earnings_rate AS earningsRate, loan_exec_no AS loanExecNo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ACCOUNT WHERE codef_connection_id = #{codefConnectionId} AND account_no_hash = #{accountNoHash}
